Rules.InvariantScript: "This is the header of the application containing the EC Logo and the Title of the Page"

SortByColumns(
    Filter(
        AllRecords,
        'Created By'.Email = User().Email && (DropdownFilterByStatus.Selected.Value = "All Status" || Status.Value = DropdownFilterByStatus.SelectedText.Value) &&
         Switch(
            LookUp(FilterOptions, Name = DropdownFilterByCoverageSubmission.Selected.Name).FilterFunction,
            "Future", 'Start Date and Time' >= Today(),
            "Last2Months", Created > DateAdd(Today(), -60),
            "Both", 'Start Date and Time' >= Today() || Created > DateAdd(Today(), -60),
            "none", true,
            true  // Default to true to show all items if no filter is selected
         )
    ),
    Text(DropdownSortOrderByDate.Selected.FilterColumn), 
    DropdownSortOrderBy.Selected.Value
)


/*
SortByColumns(
    Filter(
        'Coverage Request (Belgium)', 
        'Created By'.Email = User().Email && ('Start Date and Time' >= Today() || Created > DateAdd(Today(), -60))
    ), 
    Text(DropdownSortOrderByDate.Selected.FilterColumn), 
    DropdownSortOrderBy.Selected.Value
)
*/

"From     " & Text(ThisItem.'Start Date and Time', "[$-en-US]dd/mm/yyyy      hh:mm", "en-US") & Char(10) &
 "To          " & Text(ThisItem.'End Date and Time', "[$-en-US]dd/mm/yyyy      hh:mm", "en-US")

Switch(
    ThisItem.Status.Value,
    "New", RGBA(200, 200, 200, 1),           // Soft Grey
    "Pending Approval", RGBA(255, 255, 150, 1), // Soft Yellow
    "Accepted", RGBA(150, 255, 150, 1),       // Soft Green
    "Declined", RGBA(255, 150, 150, 1),       // Soft Red
    RGBA(0, 0, 0, 0)                          // Default color
)

"Coverage Type: " & Char(10) & ThisItem.'Event Coverage Type'.Value & Char(10) & Char(10) &
"Webstreamed: " & Char(10) &ThisItem.Webstreamed.Value & Char(10) & Char(10) &
"Webstreamed Organizer: " & Char(10) &
ThisItem.'Webstreamed Organizer'

If(
    !IsBlank(
        LookUp(ThisItem.'Coverage Type', Value = "Video Coverage")
    ),
    true,
    false
)
"Accompanying the Commissioner:" & Char(10) & Char(10) & ThisItem.'Accompanying the Commissioner'

If(ThisItem.IsSelected,
    If(IsBlank(ThisItem.'Accompanying the Commissioner'), RGBA(0, 18, 107, 0.1), RGBA(0, 18, 107, 1)),
    If(IsBlank(ThisItem.'Accompanying the Commissioner'), RGBA(100, 100, 100, 0.1), RGBA(100, 100, 100, 0.8))
)
"Contacts and Detailed Info for Accreditation:" & Char(10) & Char(10) & ThisItem.'Accreditation Info'

If(ThisItem.IsSelected,
    If(IsBlank(ThisItem.'Accreditation Info'), RGBA(0, 18, 107, 0.1), RGBA(0, 18, 107, 1)),
    If(IsBlank(ThisItem.'Accreditation Info'), RGBA(100, 100, 100, 0.1), RGBA(100, 100, 100, 0.8))
)

If(ThisItem.IsSelected,
    If(IsBlank(ThisItem.Comments), RGBA(0, 18, 107, 0.1), RGBA(0, 18, 107, 1)),
    If(IsBlank(ThisItem.Comments), RGBA(100, 100, 100, 0.1), RGBA(100, 100, 100, 0.8))
)

If(ThisItem.IsSelected,
    If(IsBlank(ThisItem.'Media Receivers'), RGBA(0, 18, 107, 0.1), RGBA(0, 18, 107, 1)),
    If(IsBlank(ThisItem.'Media Receivers'), RGBA(100, 100, 100, 0.1), RGBA(100, 100, 100, 0.8))
)
"Contacts to be Updated:" & Char(10) & Char(10) & ThisItem.'Carbon Copy Contacts'

If(ThisItem.IsSelected,
    If(IsBlank(ThisItem.'Carbon Copy Contacts'), RGBA(0, 18, 107, 0.1), RGBA(0, 18, 107, 1)),
    If(IsBlank(ThisItem.'Carbon Copy Contacts'), RGBA(100, 100, 100, 0.1), RGBA(100, 100, 100, 0.8))
)
"Coverages requested by " & Char(10) & User().FullName & Char(10) & Office365Users.MyProfileV2().department
